patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-contrast color-blocked sections define the page structure, creating distinct visual breaks and strong emotional shifts as the user scrolls.
Dramatic, oversized serif typography is used for key headings, often with a script-like quality, contrasted with clean, legible sans-serif for body text and uppercase labels.
A limited, high-contrast palette of deep black/brown, vibrant red, and soft peach is used for full-section backgrounds, creating a bold and sophisticated visual rhythm.
Sections smoothly scroll into view, replacing the previous content in a full-page transition, with the hero video playing and then receding as the user scrolls down.
The site uses a 'hero video to form' journey, starting with an immersive video, transitioning through evocative messaging, and culminating in a detailed sign-up form section.

technique_notes: A full-screen video hero plays on load, serving as an initial immersive experience before smoothly scrolling out of view to reveal the main content.

The entire page employs a smooth, scroll-driven animation system (likely locomotive-scroll) where distinct, full-bleed content sections transition seamlessly into the viewport, replacing the previous section as the user scrolls.
Key textual elements, particularly large headings, are often centered and presented with ample negative space to maximize their visual impact and readability against contrasting backgrounds.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, elegant serif display headings (~4-5x body) with smaller, clean sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with significant vertical padding between full-bleed sections and balanced spacing within content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a full-screen video hero that smoothly transitions into a series of high-contrast, full-bleed color sections, combined with dramatic, elegant typography, creates a highly immersive and emotionally impactful brand experience that feels more like a cinematic journey than a typical webpage.
